data_fields.name: hp_bar_notch_px
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (width snapped to 3k+1; fill snapped to multiples of 3)

best_idea: Show a hit-point bar only on the unit the player has selected or locked, snap its fill to a fixed 3-px notch grid so it reads as segments, and reuse the same strip for a remaining-life bar on timed summons (after fixing the divide-before-multiply defect).
decision_why: Target-frame rules are useful (bar only on the locked target, none when invincible, bands at 66 and 33, shield row above hp, remaining-life strip for timed units), but Frankendom needs one frame for lock-on and for the hate target in many-on-one fights, which the donor's per-selection rule does not give; numbers come from a pure model with the donor defects fixed.
acceptance: On a 375 px phone in a three-on-one fight the locked enemy shows one bar above its head; fill steps in 3-px notches, mid band under 66%, low band under 33%; a timed summon shows a bottom strip reaching zero at expiry; an invincible target shows no bar. Server test: energyPercent({kind:'timed', left:675, total:1350}) returns 50 and barModel returns null for an invincible unit.
